Name: Agumon Dinosaur Replacer (CP)
Author: UlyanaLeyana
Description:
A content patcher version of two mods that change a dinosaur to agumon. +some new colors, 8 in total.


[b][color=#cc0000][size=4]Install[/size][/color][/b][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of[url=https://smapi.io/] SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿  version 1.20.0 or higher.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI once to generate config.json
[*]Edit config.json to your liking.
[/list][b]

[/b][b]Config options[/b]:
"Agumon Color" : "black" "blue" "orange" "pink" "purple" "red" "snow" "yellow" ("Default": "yellow")

Enjoy!




[b]Original mods[/b]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2164]Agumon - Dinosaur Replacer[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3276]DW3 Agumon Dinosaur Replacer[/url]﻿﻿﻿
[b]Creator[/b]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3992452]Dragonyck[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/143983]boofdawg[/url]﻿
Permission was given by the authors.
